sanskrit:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥ १४-२॥
iast:
idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ
sarge’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca 14-2
translation: They who, having refuge in this Knowledge have attained to My Being, are neither born at the time of Creation, nor are they disturbed at the time of dissolution.
